title: The continuum tree limit of FK maps above weight four
exact_target: For every fixed real $q>4$, is there $c(q)>0$ such that the degree-measured spherical n-edge FK map with graph distance multiplied by $c(q)n^{-1/2}$ converges in Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov law to the Brownian continuum random tree, through all n?
